All rights reserved. 6 Selection process Your application is reviewed to check eligibility and alignment with the program based on your academic background and field of study. This round evaluates your core technical knowledge, logical reasoning, and aptitude relevant to your academic level. You will participate in a group discussion to assess communication skills, clarity of thought, teamwork, and problem- solving ability.
